messages.en:
{07 14 00}The {ff 00 00 03}Fireworks Show{ff 00 00 00} has
finally started,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}Fireworks are like flowers
that bloom in the night
sky{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 14 00} {07 13 00}They're just like me!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}{ff 00 00 03}Ilutulestikushow{ff 00 00 00} on
lõpuks alanud,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}Ilutulestikud on nagu lilled,
mis õitsevad öötaevas{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 14 00} {07 13 00}Nad
on just nagu mina!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}The {ff 00 00 03}Fireworks Show {ff 00 00 00}has
finally started! I'm so
so SO happy!
{07 0d 00}I'm going to have as much 
fun as I possibly can
tonight! You should, too!{07 00 00}
messages.et:
{07 14 00}{ff 00 00 03}Ilutulestikushow {ff 00 00 00}on
lõpuks alanud! Ma olen nii
väga-väga rõõmus!
{07 0d 00}Ma kavatsen täna õhtul
nii palju lõbutseda kui
võimalik! Sina peaksid ka!{07 00 00}

messages.en:
You still haven't seen {07 1b 00}the
best of the best yet
tonight, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 0d 00}Hey, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}, we're
going to have a great time!
I can just feel it!
messages.et:
Sa pole veel näinud {07 1b 00}
täna õhtul kõige
paremat, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 0d 00}Hei, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}, meil tuleb
suurepärane aeg!
Ma lihtsalt tunnen seda!

messages.en:
{07 0e 00}The opening isn't too showy,
and the end is calm and
understated{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.
{07 14 00}The fireworks this year
have grown more mature,
just like me, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 0e 00}Algus pole liiga uhke
ja lõpp on rahulik ja
tagasihoidlik{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.
{07 14 00}Selle aasta ilutulestik
on küpsemaks saanud,
just nagu mina, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 16 00}I think the fireworks might
be ending pretty soon.

{07 19 00}I hope the ending is super
explosive, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!{07 14 00}
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Ma arvan, et ilutulestik
võib üsna pea lõppeda.

{07 19 00}Loodan, et lõpp on ülimalt
plahvatuslik, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!{07 14 00}

messages.en:
You know,{01 00 00 0f 00} {07 14 00}they're so
beautiful that they kind of
make me sad.
{07 1c 00}{01 00 00 05 00}It's already been a year
since that summer{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 01 00} {07 00 00}A
whole year, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
Tead,{01 00 00 0f 00} {07 14 00}nad on nii
ilusad, et teevad mind
kuidagi kurvaks.
{07 1c 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Sellest suvest on juba
aasta möödas{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 01 00} {07 00 00}Terve
aasta, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Wow!{01 00 00 0f 00} The fireworks this
year were so powerful!

{07 0a 00}I'm gonna strive to be just
like them: strong AND
beautiful, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Vau!{01 00 00 0f 00} Selle aasta ilutulestik
oli nii võimas!

{07 0a 00}Ma püüan olla just nagu
nemad: tugev JA
ilus, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 12 00}Just listening to the
fireworks jolts away a
week's worth of stress.
messages.et:
{07 12 00}Ainuüksi ilutulestiku
kuulamine raputab nädala
stressi minema.

messages.en:
{07 19 00}This town has got to be the
only one doing a {ff 00 00 03}Fireworks
Show{ff 00 00 00} this awesome.
{07 0a 00}I, for one,{01 00 00 05 00} am proud to be
a resident of {04 03 00},
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 19 00}See linn peab olema ainus,
kus tehakse nii vägevat
{ff 00 00 03}ilutulestikushowd{ff 00 00 00}.
{07 0a 00}Mina olen{01 00 00 05 00} uhke, et olen
{04 03 00} elanik,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 13 00}Just once,{01 00 00 05 00} I'd like to be 
able to look down on the
fireworks exploding!
{07 00 00}But{01 00 00 05 00} before I can do that,
I have to grow even taller
{07 1c 00}{01 00 00 05 00}than a supermodel.
messages.et:
{07 13 00}Kasvõi korra{01 00 00 05 00} tahaksin ma
vaadata ülevalt alla
plahvatavale ilutulestikule!
{07 00 00}Aga{01 00 00 05 00} enne seda pean ma
kasvama veel pikemaks
{07 1c 00}{01 00 00 05 00}kui supermodell.

messages.en:
{07 1c 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Next week is the end of
the{ff 00 00 03} Fireworks Show{ff 00 00 00}{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.
What a bummer.
{07 16 00}I guess that means that 
summer's almost over
too, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 1c 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Järgmisel nädalal on
{ff 00 00 03}ilutulestikushow{ff 00 00 00} läbi{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.
Milline pettumus.
{07 16 00}See tähendab vist, et ka
suvi on peaaegu
läbi, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.

{07 00 00}Minu mälestus sellest
suvest oli{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}. {07 06 00}Öök,{01 00 00 05 00} ei,{01 00 00 05 00} ma ei
suuda sellest rääkida.
{07 09 00}Ma pean lihtsalt ruttu
ta ära unustama{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.

messages.en:
{07 16 00}It's kinda sad to think that
I won't be able to watch 
fireworks for a while.
messages.et:
{07 16 00}On kuidagi kurb mõelda, et
ma ei saa mõnda aega
ilutulestikku vaadata.
